decisions.statement: This check holds a property page to the one parent every page already has.
A property page sits in the `properties` folder beside the page naming it a part.
A property carrying properties of its own heads a folder in that folder.
A property page deeper than such a folder is refused.
A property page sitting anywhere else is refused.
A property page no page names a part is refused beside this check.
A property page two pages name a part is refused beside this check.
A property page either of those reaches is passed over here.
The page naming a property page a part is a page type, a domain or a property.
A file beside a property page is no property page.
A page of any other type is let through.
Which pages name a property a part is read as the change leaves those pages.
A change writing any page's parts is judged, not a change writing a property alone.
Which page types declare the property is not judged here.
Nothing is judged while this page states `experimental`.
`experimental` comes off this page where Alan has approved this check.
Alan approved this check in the turn that asked for it.
This check judges at every phase.

definition: the check refusing a property page outside the `properties` folder of the page naming it a part
